title: Liver
description: Plates of hepatocytes radiating from central veins, with portal tracts at the corners of the lobules.
look_for: Hepatocytes: large polygonal cells in plates, with one or two round nuclei
Sinusoids: the pale spaces between the plates of hepatocytes
Central veins (terminal hepatic venules): thin-walled veins with no bile duct beside them
A portal tract: a branch of the portal vein and small bile ducts in connective tissue (the branch of the hepatic artery is small and hard to pick out here)

labels.find: a branch of the portal vein

labels.text: Plates of hepatocytes, with sinusoids between them
